secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for AI scenario analysis. Obtain from Google AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Optional — app falls back to a deterministic analysis engine without it.

secrets.name: OPLAB_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: OpLab REST API v3 access token for live B3 market data. Obtain from https://go.oplab.com.br/api. Optional — app falls back to a B3 ticker parser/estimator without it.
